name: arm D: block-level AI on can't-call votes
rule: for each can't-call vote of arm C (|p-.5|<.31): p = sigmoid(logit(pC) + w*logit(AI block chance)); call if |p-.5| >= cutoff
learned_on: 2025 + 2026 pilot bills (295 bills, 1,834 can't-call votes; B139 and 4 recognized bills excluded)
pass_2027: calls > 0 and right >= 81% on 2027 can't-call votes of AI-rated bills; same packet builder and instructions; recognized bills dropped
